name: DNA polymerase delta 1, catalytic subunit

function.text: POLD1 encodes the catalytic subunit of DNA polymerase delta, which participates in DNA replication and repair and provides proofreading exonuclease activity.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to POLD1-related polyposis and colorectal cancer syndrome (autosomal dominant); mandibular hypoplasia-deafness-progeroid syndrome (autosomal dominant). Additional curated associations are listed below.

somatic.text: Somatic sequence alterations have cohort-level candidate-driver evidence in Esophageal Adenocarcinoma; Invasive Breast Carcinoma. This gene-level statistical evidence requires allele-specific review and does not establish the effect of every variant.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
